# Wharf 0.1.0 implementation changes

## Completed

- Initialized root module `github.com/bartr/wharf` for Go 1.27 and pinned Cobra
  1.10.2.
- Added the thin `cmd/wharf` process boundary.
- Added internal packages for command construction, typed global
  configuration, logging and redaction, versioning, and exit-code mapping.
- Added the complete v1 command tree. Operational commands fail explicitly as
  unimplemented in 0.1.0.
- Added semver-only `version` and `--version`, Bash/Zsh completion, strict
  unknown-input behavior, repeatable verbosity, quiet mode, and text/JSON
  console selection.
- Added a separate always-JSON durable logger API, schema versioning, typed
  secret attributes, and an injectable redaction hook.
- Added package tests, compiled-binary integration tests, and golden help
  fixtures.
- Added and documented `./scripts/validate-wharf.sh`.
- Updated repository memory with permanent module, package, version,
  environment, validation, and exit-code decisions.

## Implementation validation

- `go test ./internal/version ./internal/exitcode ./internal/config`: passed.
- `go test ./internal/logging`: passed.
- `go test ./internal/command`: passed, including root and subcommand help
  goldens.
- `go test ./cmd/wharf`: passed, including compiled default and linker-injected
  versions.
- `./scripts/validate-wharf.sh`: passed after the final implementation change.
  It formatted sources, ran `go vet`, ran all Wharf tests, and built the
  executable.
- Direct compiled CLI proof passed:
  - source version: `0.1.0`
  - injected version: `1.2.3-test`
  - root and subcommand help: generated
  - Bash and Zsh completion: generated
  - unknown command: exit 2
  - unknown flag: exit 2
  - operational placeholder: exit 1
- A source search found exactly one `var Version =` declaration.
- The dependency manifests contain no Viper reference.

## Plan departure

Cobra's automatic `--version` flag printed the version and returned success for
`wharf --version unknown`. That violated explicit unknown-command rejection.
The implementation now uses an explicit root `--version` flag, preserving exact
semver output while allowing Cobra to reject trailing unknown input with exit
code 2.

The first review pass found and returned two defects to implementation:

- configuration now selects the highest-precedence source before parsing, so a
  valid changed flag bypasses an invalid lower-precedence environment value;
- version, help, completion, and configuration failures are explicitly typed,
  so output I/O failures map to internal failure while user input remains
  invalid input.

Focused regression tests cover both boundaries, and the complete validation
command passed again after the fixes.

The post-implementation code review found additional release blockers:

- configured command errors now use the selected text or JSON logger;
- help output validates targets and propagates write failures;
- test subprocesses receive a sanitized Wharf environment;
- operational placeholder errors read the effective linker-overridden version;
- uncategorized execution failures default to internal failure.

These fixes passed `./scripts/validate-wharf.sh`, race-enabled tests, and
compiled CLI proofs for help rejection, JSON errors, linker overrides, and
stable exit codes.

## Release

The 0.1.0 release is approved after the corrected review. The branch is ready
for a local commit, push, fast-forward merge to `main`, and annotated release
tag `0.1.0`.
